description: This file defines functions and data structures for managing GitHub labels via GraphQL API, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting labels within repositories.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Retrieves a specific label by name from a GitHub repository using GraphQL.

methods.name: ListLabels
methods.description: Lists all labels from a specified GitHub repository.

methods.name: LabelWrite
methods.description: Performs create, update, or delete operations on GitHub labels based on provided method.
